title: Twelve-month outcomes of single-step transepithelial photorefractive keratectomy for moderate hyperopia and hyperopic astigmatism

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <permissions>/<license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License; CC0 waiver for data)

indication: moderate hyperopia or hyperopic astigmatism (inclusion by cycloplegic SEQ, sphere, cylinder and keratometry limits as stated in Methods)

groups.description: Single-step transepithelial PRK (StreamLight, WaveLight EX500), mitomycin C 0.02% mid-peripherally, bandage lens; 48 eyes of 30 patients; prospective, single surgeon; correction based on full cycloplegic refraction without a specific nomogram

series.notes: mean ± SE as labelled in Table 2 (C2 'Mean ± SE'); columns Preoperative, Postoperative 6 months and 12 months; per-visit n not reported (48 eyes completed the planned follow-up)

exclusions.what: Table 2 cycloplegic SEQ row (R8) at the same visits
exclusions.reason: both manifest and cycloplegic SE are tabulated; the manifest SE is extracted per the extraction brief

exclusions.what: Table 2 Range rows and P value columns (C6-C9)
exclusions.reason: ranges and p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: Figure 1 standard graphs (attempted versus achieved SEQ, accuracy within ±0.5 D, stability)
exclusions.reason: attempted-versus-achieved fits and proportions are not admissible; figures are not citable cells
listed in Methods but not tabulated

notes: Target: Methods state postoperative emmetropia was targeted in all eyes; target recorded as plano.

Method: Methods state that both manifest and full cycloplegic refraction were measured with the auto-keratorefractometer KR-8900 (Topcon) and that pre- and postoperative assessments used the same tools; recorded as objective (autorefraction) for the row labelled 'Manifest SEQ'.
Attrition: 58 eyes of 38 patients collected; eight patients dropped out; 48 eyes of 30 patients completed the planned follow-up and are analysed (not outcome-defined).
Bilaterally treated patients contribute both eyes (fellow-eye correlation).
Table 2 also tabulates UDVA, CDVA, cycloplegic sphere and cylinder, mean keratometry and Q value (not extracted; schema 1.0.0 has no such series).
